grammar.summary: 本课学习分词作伴随状语（综合运用）。

points.title: 现在分词作伴随状语
points.explanation: The man was lying on the wall, trying to repair... 主句动作进行的同时伴随发生的动作用 V-ing 短语。

examples.en: He was lying there, pretending to be asleep.

points.title: 表评价的 what a... 复现
points.explanation: What a nuisance! = 真讨厌！感叹句复现，语气工具箱。

examples.en: What on earth are you doing?
